alpha_caveat: Alpha was chosen on development origins from the declared grid, and the chosen value sits at the grid's edge, which usually means the grid is misplaced. It is reported as a limit rather than widened: extending the grid now would be choosing it after seeing these results. A wider grid has to be declared before a future run, not after this one.
limits: A comparison, not a selection. The promotion rule (delta_min, disjoint four-week blocks, n >= 12) is P4 and is not applied here; M0 remains the provisional Champion. These weeks are correlated, so the counts are descriptive and support no significance or equivalence claim.

loss_scale.method: mean absolute week-over-week difference of eligible labels

config.declared_in: P2 model comparison, declared 2026-10-18 before any candidate was scored
config.promotion_rule: not applied here; selection is P4

stratum_caveat: The delayed_publication stratum is one outage observed several times: every origin in it shares the same last visible week, the same target week and the same label. Its effective support is the number of distinct target weeks reported beside it, not the number of origins, and it supports no comparison between candidates.

support.rule: One row per target week, keeping the earliest origin. A stalled publication leaves the last visible week fixed while the calendar advances, so several origins forecast the same week from the same state; counting origins would weight that week once per origin.

universe.decision_a: Sunday-displaced cuts are excluded by calendar rule, asserted above, never by looking at prediction error.
